crosswalk_method: Active MOIS KIKcd_B and KIKcd_H joined by KIKmix, effective 2026-09-30, freshly downloaded 2026-10-10. Canonical units exclude city aggregate and all lower-level legal ri. Yangju municipal overview corroborates 1 eup,4 myeon,7 administrative dongs (12 administrative units); these are not the 17 legal dongs. Deokjeong-dong spans Hoecheon 1-dong and Hoecheon 3-dong; Okjeong-dong spans Okjeong 1-dong and Okjeong 2-dong. Each of these four relationships is partial; parcel boundaries are not inferred. Former Hoecheon 4-dong is not current. Future-effective October12 dataset excluded. MOIS is authoritative for partial scopes. Fresh municipal jurisdiction blocks independently corroborate all22 canonical names and all24 administrative/legal pairs; the obsolete Hoecheon4 block inside an HTML comment was excluded. City overview independently corroborates administrative aggregate.
